description: This file defines a Java interface 'MessageConsumer' that provides methods for consuming messages from a Hono server, including closing the connection, managing message credits, and checking remaining credits.

classes.name: MessageConsumer
classes.description: An interface for consuming messages from a Hono server, providing methods to close the consumer, flow messages, and check remaining credits.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the AMQP link with the Hono server asynchronously using a handler callback.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Provides a certain number of message credits to the sender, potentially throwing an exception if the state does not permit.

methods.name: getRemainingCredit
methods.description: Returns the number of additional messages the consumer can receive at the current time.
